weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.description: A spiked iron ball on a wooden handle. Crude but effective against the undead.
weapons.notes: Intentionally weak starter weapon - encourages buying first upgrade

weapons.name: Rusty Dagger
weapons.description: A worn blade that's seen better days. Strikes fast, hits hard.

weapons.name: Iron Short Sword
weapons.description: A reliable iron blade. Standard issue for wasteland survivors.

weapons.name: Bone Mace
weapons.description: Crafted from skeleton bones. Surprisingly effective and well-balanced.

weapons.name: Bronze Spear
weapons.description: An ancient weapon with surprising reach and precision.

weapons.name: Steel Longsword
weapons.description: Well-balanced blade forged from quality steel. A knight's companion.

weapons.name: Iron Warhammer
weapons.description: A massive weapon that crushes undead with devastating force. Slow but brutally powerful.

weapons.name: Silver Rapier
weapons.description: A slender blade that strikes with lightning speed. Precision over power.

weapons.name: Azureblade
weapons.description: A legendary sword wreathed in ethereal blue flames. Its light never fades.
weapons.notes: Legendary drop - higher crit than normal fast weapons

weapons.name: Crimsonfury
weapons.description: A legendary blade burning with crimson fire. Forged in the heart of the Abyss.
weapons.notes: Legendary drop - higher crit than normal fast weapons

weapons.name: Healing Staff
weapons.description: Channel restorative energy to heal nearby allies. Click to create a healing circle at your cursor.
weapons.notes: Starter healing weapon - heals group members within circle radius
